item.title: Sewage smell, 9th August
item.description:
I live a number 47Selby road. And a wish to strongly complain about the terrible sewage smells coming from the Lorrie’s parked at Clark’s Haulage 83 Penge Rd, London SE20 7UN which have not been cleaned prior to parking up for the weekend. The strong smell or raw sewage has gone right through our house and clothes and our neighbours residents property’s as well. Please can they but told not to allow this to happen again( it is not the first time this has happened). Now I understand the need for small businesses to operate in the area for jobs etc: but why can’t they run a hose and clean the back of the trucks before parking up of a weekend and just letting the smell linger. I honestly feel like throwing up, it’s that bad. Yours sincerely William Scarr.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 93, Penge Road, Anerley, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
